mintAuthority.summary: USDso inherits frxUSD issuance, with a local role-gated token and collateral-taking BrandedCustodian. A 3-of-6 Safe controls token upgrades, factory upgrades and the custodian beacon; owner-only collateral recovery exists in code without an established current factory forwarding route.

controls.label: USDso token ProxyAdmin owner

sources.label: USDso terms: Frax issuer and no Somnia redemption/yield obligation
Frax parent reserve balance sheet (issuer telemetry)

controls.evidence: At block 428274392, token EIP-1967 admin is 0x3281f2a1e0a3b818353f859c868c44748154b196, whose owner() returns 0x9527e19f55d1afce9f1e9edcea79552bf41983f9. Safe threshold and owner count were read at the same block; complete modules, guards, signer independence and key custody remain unresolved. At Somnia block 428274392, custodian owner() returned BrandedFactory proxy 0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d. Its owner field returned the same 3-of-6 Safe. The current BrandedCustodian code permits onlyOwner recoverERC20 of any token, including reserve frxUSD, and owner changes to caps, fees and isolated backing. No generic forwarding call for these functions was found in the current factory implementation, so direct Safe execution of the recovery function is not established. The Safe nevertheless owns both the factory ProxyAdmin (0xc1282f16dfb0ae563a93c40a406a583bd9a958a0) and custodian UpgradeableBeacon (0x251d07287c12707418a414b2c95436b4216b7bf4), enabling replacement of custody and issuance logic.

controls.evidence: Fresh token hasRole(MINTER_ROLE,custodian)=true. Verified deposit/mint transfers frxUSD into custody before minting USDso, updates brandedCoinMinted, and checks mintCap. Current mintCap is uint256 maximum, so the configured amount ceiling is not restrictive. Asset custody and supply were equal at the pin.
